title: Be used to / get used to
note: Contrast with used to (past habit) · be used to + -ing/noun · get used to + -ing/noun · thin shell 2026-08-06

cards.title: used to ≠ be used to ≠ get used to
cards.title_cz: used to ≠ be used to ≠ get used to
cards.body: **used to + base** = past habit (no longer true). **be used to + noun/-ing** = be familiar with something. **get used to + noun/-ing** = become familiar. Same letters, different grammar.
cards.body_cz: **used to + základ** = dřívější zvyk. **be used to + podstatné/-ing** = být zvyklý. **get used to** = zvyknout si. Stejná písmena, jiná gramatika.

blocks.title: Be used to / get used to · B2

items.en: I'm used to getting up early.
accepts: I'm used to getting up early.
I am used to getting up early.
items.explanation: be used to + -ing = familiar with a situation.

items.en: She isn't used to the noise yet.
items.cz: Ještě není zvyklá na ten hluk.
items.gap: She isn't used ____ the noise yet.
accepts: She isn't used to the noise yet.
She is not used to the noise yet.

items.en: You'll get used to driving on the left.
items.gap: You'll get used to ____ on the left.
accepts: You'll get used to driving on the left.
You will get used to driving on the left.

items.en: I used to live in Prague.
accepts: I used to live in Prague.
items.explanation: used to + base = past habit (contrast item).

items.en: He's getting used to his new job.
items.gap: He's getting used ____ his new job.
accepts: He's getting used to his new job.
He is getting used to his new job.

items.en: We were used to working long hours.
items.gap: We were used to ____ long hours.
accepts: We were used to working long hours.
items.explanation: be used to in the past.

items.en: Did you use to play football?
accepts: Did you use to play football?
items.explanation: Question form of past habit: did + use to.
items.explanation_cz: Otázka na dřívější zvyk: did + use to.

items.en: It took months to get used to the climate.
items.cz: Trvalo měsíce, než jsem si zvykl na klima.
items.gap: It took months to get used ____ the climate.
accepts: It took months to get used to the climate.

items.en: I'm not used to being alone.
accepts: I'm not used to being alone.
I am not used to being alone.

items.en: They never got used to living abroad.
items.cz: Nikdy si nezvykli žít v cizině.
items.gap: They never got used to ____ abroad.
accepts: They never got used to living abroad.
